title: The Elf Who Lost Santa's List
tagline: A North Pole wind scattered Santa's list. Find every page before Christmas Eve!

checklist: Print and cut the list pages
Hide pages #2 through #10 using the hiding spot guide
Put the List Complete card under the Christmas tree (add a small treat or gift if you like)
Keep page #1 in your hand to start

intro.speaker: elf
lines: Oh, thank goodness you're here! I'm Juniper, and I keep Santa's list.
I was carrying it to the workshop when a big gust of North Pole wind blew the pages right out of my hands... and all over this house!
Santa needs the whole list by Christmas Eve. {name}, will you help me and Pip find every page?
Here's the first one. Let's go!

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Oh no, the pages flew away! Look where it's chilly, cold all day.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: One page floated way up high, where the stockings hang nearby.
steps.hint: Where do your Christmas stockings hang?
steps.spot: Stockings or fireplace (or a window ledge)

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Even elves wash up each day. Check the sink, a page blew that way!
steps.hint: Where do you wash your hands?

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: Snuggle time is almost here. Check the couch, the page is near!

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Santa loves a story too. Look where books are lined up for you.

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: Sugarplums dance in sleepy heads. Look for a page tucked in the beds!
steps.hint: Check a bed or under a pillow.

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Snowy boots go by the door. Check the shoes for one page more!
steps.hint: Look where the shoes and boots are kept.
steps.spot: Shoes or boots by the door

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: The workshop makes a lot of toys. Check the toy box, girls and boys!

steps.speaker: elf
steps.riddle: Cookies for Santa, milk in a cup. Look where the spoons are all stacked up!
steps.hint: Check the spoon drawer in the kitchen.
steps.spot: Kitchen utensil drawer or cookie jar

steps.speaker: pip
steps.riddle: One last page and then we're done! Look under the tree for the very last one!

found: You found a page! Juniper is so relieved!
Pip is doing a happy hop!

finale.artAlt: Juniper the Elf and Pip the Reindeer cheering with Santa's list
finale.title: Santa's List Is Saved!
lines: You found every single page! Santa's list is complete.
Thank you, {name}. You're officially a North Pole helper!

print.subtitle: A printable Christmas page hunt where kids find the pieces of Santa's list before Christmas Eve.
coverFeatures: 10 clue cards styled as Santa's torn list pages
Quest Master on your phone: reads the clues, gives hints, throws the confetti
Blank pages for your own hiding spots
print.storyTitle: A Letter from the North Pole
storyLines: It's Juniper, Santa's list-keeper elf. I have a teeny, tiny problem.
I was carrying Santa's list to the workshop when a gust of North Pole wind blew the pages right out of my mittens. They landed all over your house!
Santa needs every page by Christmas Eve. Pip the reindeer and I can't do it without you.
Follow the clues. Each page you find leads to the next one.
Your first page is in your hands...

startCard.speaker: elf
startCard.title: Help! The List Is Lost!
startCard.text: A North Pole wind blew Santa's list away! Help me find every page before Christmas Eve!

print.parentTip: Play it on Christmas Eve morning or the first day of winter break. Turn on the tree lights and some Christmas music before you start.

tips.title: Elf workshop craft station
tips.text: Let helpers make their North Pole gear while everyone gathers.
list: Paper elf hats with a bell or pom-pom
Paper chains to count down the pages
Reindeer antler headbands from brown paper strips

tips.title: Set the scene
list: Christmas music and tree lights only
Tape a "North Pole Mail" sign on the front door
Give the lead helper a title, like Head Elf

tips.title: North Pole snacks
tips.text: Save these for after the list is saved.
list: Reindeer food: snack mix with pretzels and chocolate candies
Candy cane quills for writing Santa a note

tips.title: Save Christmas
tips.text: When the last page turns up under the tree, read the whole list together. Then each helper writes one wish on a blank page to send to Santa.

certificate.title: Official North Pole Helper
certificate.body: for finding every missing page of Santa's list just in time for Christmas.
certificate.signer: Juniper the Elf & Pip the Reindeer

print.backLine: If your helpers loved this adventure, more holiday quests are on the way.
